Method of Attack: Distributed through malicious Windows App Installer packages pretending to be Adobe PDF software
Phishing emails with reply-chain emails containing links to fake PDF documents
Use of ms-appinstaller URL to open appinstaller files hosted on Microsoft Azure
Installation of malicious appxbundle that installs DLL in %Temp% and executes it with rundll32.exe
Copying DLL as randomly named file and folder in %LocalAppData%
Creation of autorun registry entry under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run to launch DLL on Windows startup
Attack Vector: Windows App Installer feature exploiting ms-appinstaller protocol
Malicious packages hosted on Microsoft Azure
Indicators of Compromise: Randomly named files and folders in %LocalAppData%
